form_name: ACORD 133 - Workers Compensation Insurance Plan (Assigned Risk) Section
description: Workers Compensation Insurance Plan / Assigned Risk section. The template's own first page reads 'WORKERS COMPENSATION INSURANCE PLAN - ASSIGNED RISK SECTION' and states it must be attached to an ACORD 130 Workers Compensation Application to constitute an application for assigned-risk coverage. 67 of its 136 fields are WorkersCompensation*; it has no builders-risk field.
